pages.title: Contract of Honor
pages.text: $(thing)Right-click$() a mercenary to open the $(thing)Contract of Honor$(). It shows their name, rank and price.$(br2)If you carry enough $(item)Gold Coins$(), press $(thing)Seal Pact$(). The coins are taken from your inventory and the mercenary swears loyalty to you.

pages.title: Ranks and Prices
pages.text: The price depends on the gear they come with:$(br)$(li)$(thing)Recruit$(): leather and wood, level 1, 20 to 30 coins.$(li)$(thing)Veteran$(): chainmail, stone and shield, level 2, 40 to 50 coins.$(li)$(thing)Elite$(): iron and shield, level 3, 60 to 80 coins.$(br2)Their starting gear is yours to keep and upgrade.

pages.title: Rescuing a Prisoner
pages.text: A prisoner joins you for free. $(thing)Right-click$() them holding $(item)food$(), a $(item)potion$() or a $(item)sword or axe$().$(br2)They are healed, lose their weakness and swear loyalty. A weapon you hand over goes straight to their main hand.
